queries.title: Every span that failed
queries.why: The first search in any error incident. `has_error` is true when span status is Error.

queries.title: Failures in one service
queries.why: Narrow to the service you suspect.

queries.title: The crash scenario
queries.why: Lab 1 has no scenario attribute, so use the URL path. `http.target` is recorded for you.
queries.expr: service.name = 'lab1-frontend' AND http.target = '/api/scenario/crash' AND has_error = true

filter.expression: service.name = 'lab1-frontend' AND http.target = '/api/scenario/crash' AND has_error = true

queries.title: One scenario, by its URL path
queries.why: Every scenario shares one operation name, so `http.target` is what tells them apart in Lab 1.

queries.title: Anything slower than one second

queries.title: Slow requests, not slow internals

queries.title: One backend route

queries.why: The deepest failing span in the `backend_500` scenario.
queries.expr: service.name = 'lab1-backend' AND name = 'GET /work/fail' AND has_error = true

filter.expression: service.name = 'lab1-backend' AND name = 'GET /work/fail' AND has_error = true

queries.title: Find SQL by its text
queries.why: `db.statement` is recorded by the agent, with no changes to your queries.

queries.title: Slow database calls
queries.why: Half a second is very slow for this app's SQL.

queries.title: Failed database calls
queries.why: The exception event sits on this span, not on the backend Server span.
queries.expr: service.name = 'lab1-backend' AND db.system = 'postgresql' AND has_error = true

filter.expression: service.name = 'lab1-backend' AND db.system = 'postgresql' AND has_error = true

queries.title: Server errors by HTTP status
queries.why: Compares numerically. Empty on non-HTTP spans.

queries.title: Client errors, which has_error misses
queries.why: A 4xx leaves span status Unset, so filter on the status code.

queries.title: Outgoing calls that timed out
queries.why: A failed Client span that lasted about as long as the 1-second limit. Works without knowing the route.
queries.expr: service.name = 'lab1-frontend' AND kind_string = 'Client' AND has_error = true AND duration_nano > 900000000

filter.expression: service.name = 'lab1-frontend' AND kind_string = 'Client' AND has_error = true AND duration_nano > 900000000

queries.title: Hide the ASGI send and receive spans
queries.why: These zero-length spans crowd every result.
queries.expr: service.name = 'lab1-backend' AND name NOT CONTAINS 'http send' AND name NOT CONTAINS 'http receive'

filter.expression: service.name = 'lab1-backend' AND name NOT CONTAINS 'http send' AND name NOT CONTAINS 'http receive'

queries.title: The route that burned CPU
